meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct.description: Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct; a plain non-reasoning chat model. Kept as a fallback for plain chat because it does not support structured output; the runtime/default model is zai-org/glm-5.3-flash (see evidence.liveMatrix)

zai-org/glm-5.3-flash.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 Flash — Novita's own served default and the model exercised end-to-end by NeuroLink's live capability probe (chat, streaming, tool calling, tools+streaming, tools+schema together). Reasons internally via `reasoning_content` before answering, so it needs a generous max_tokens budget or replies get cut mid-thought — pin `testModel` here for the capability matrix. Pricing from the authenticated roster, 2026-09-05

liveMatrix.result: 18-probe harness against zai-org/glm-5.3-flash (Novita's own served default) via https://api.novita.ai/openai/v1. Wire mechanics: chat, system role, array content parts, sampling params and max_completion_tokens all 200; SSE streaming 200 with a usage chunk and a terminal [DONE]. Reasoning is genuinely heavy on this model — several 200 responses show finish_reason=length with only 8 completion tokens, entirely spent on an unfinished reasoning_content and an empty visible content — but `default` and `testModel` are both pinned to the probed model itself (zai-org/glm-5.3-flash, Novita's own served default), which is exactly what the capability matrix below exercises — see the structured-output findings further down for why the reasoning-heavy default is still the right choice over the plain meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct fallback. Tool calling: a real tool_call (get_time, parsed tz argument) on the first turn, a null-content assistant tool_calls turn accepted on replay, and a tool_call surfacing mid-SSE-stream — tools and toolsWithStreaming true; tool_choice is tolerated even with no tools declared. response_format json_object returns 200 cleanly — structuredOutput true. response_format json_schema also returns 200, but at this token budget the content is unfinished reasoning text rather than schema-conformant JSON, same reasoning-budget effect as above — NeuroLink's coerceJsonToSchema repair layer is the safety net here, as for other reasoning-heavy vendors. Sending tools and a JSON schema together in one request succeeds (200, real tool_call returned) at the wire level. That single-shot result alone does not demonstrate the combined capability — the follow-up turn where the model must answer the original JSON-schema question from a tool result was untested at raw-probe time. It was proved separately through the SDK's public surface: `generate({ provider: 'novita', schema, ...})` with a registered getTime tool called end-to-end via dist/index.js — the model invoked getTime(tz='Asia/Tokyo') (toolsUsed=['getTime'], stepsUsed=2), then answered `{"city":"Tokyo","time":"09:00"}`, which parsed against the request schema with no repair needed (jsonRepaired/jsonTruncated both unset) — passed 1/1 in the final live proof. structuredOutputWithTools is declared true on that basis. Vision: a 64x64 PNG sent to glm-5.3-flash (not a vision-tagged model; Novita has no live-verified vision model) returns 200 with reasoning_content correctly describing 'a solid blue rectangle' but an EMPTY final content — not a working, schema-usable vision reply, so no catalog entry is marked vision:true and models.visionModel is left unset. bad key -> 401 {"code":401,"reason":"FAILED_TO_AUTH","message":"failed to authenticate API key"}; bad model -> 404 {"code":404,"reason":"MODEL_NOT_FOUND","message":"model not found"}. Novita funds this account with a $1 Model API voucher, so only this one model was live-probed end-to-end; the other four catalog entries are roster-verified by id only, not capability-probed. Structured output on Novita is per-model, and the catalog schema can only express it per provider. Verified 2026-09-05 at the wire: meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct returns HTTP 400 for response_format json_schema ("does not support 'json_schema' response format. Supported formats: json_object") and also 400 for json_object, while zai-org/glm-5.3-flash returns 200 for json_object, json_schema and tools+json_schema together. The default is therefore zai-org/glm-5.3-flash, which is also Novita's own served default, so the provider-level structuredOutput and structuredOutputWithTools flags are true for the model a default-configuration caller actually gets. meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct remains a fallback for plain chat. Tool calling was verified separately on both models (finish_reason=tool_calls with a structured call). Note that glm-5.3-flash is a reasoning model: at very small max_tokens (observed at 40) the budget is consumed by reasoning and content comes back empty; the entry's defaultMaxOutputTokens of 4096 is well clear of that.
